atomic_placeholder_rule: any placeholder U+2460-2473 (1-20) inside IDS -> whole char atomic: primary=char, secondary='~', t2=1, flag COMPOSITE_PLACEHOLDER; needs stroke data else MISSING_ANCHOR_STROKES (excluded, reported separately)
placeholder_char_range: PLACEHOLDER_CHARS = frozenset(chr(cp) for cp in range(0x2460, 0x2474))
